newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Credit Suisse says 1997 began positively.
newsitem.headline: Credit Suisse says 1997 began positively.

text.p: Credit Suisse Group, after reporting a 2.43 billion Swiss franc 1996 loss, said the current year had begun on a positive note.
"The year 1997 has begun positively, and we are therefore very confident of our ability to reach the goals we have set," the company said in a statement released ahead of a news conference.
But it also said that it had a good deal of work ahead, especially in quickly transforming the meaasures it had already adopted into lasting cost reductions.
